title: How a Godly Man Handles Being Called Out
caption:
Your first move when someone calls you out isn't a defense. It's a decision.

Most men answer a correction with a reason. Feel the sting first, ask if it's true before you explain yourself, and let the wound actually land. Proverbs 27:6 says wounds from a friend can be trusted. If it doesn't sting a little, it probably isn't honest.

The test isn't whether you can take criticism. It's whether Tuesday looks different because of it.

#faith #godlyman #correction #humility #brotherhood #christianmen #proverbs
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
